notes.title: Duty calls to service! Furry Hitler 2 is out and ready to be discovered! 🎉
notes.notes:
It's finally time to get immersed into the furry interpretation of 1940s Germany and take part in the story of fuhrer himself
going to a small town on an inspection visit and getting intertwined into the local secrets - sometimes really intriguing ones,
sometimes important, and often - hot ones. 
A handful of lovely and sexy furry, a distinctive visual style, a lot of hot 18+ scenes 
and overall comforting gameplay are calling you for a visit!
We hope you'll enjoy our new endeavors as much as we 
enjoyed working on them. 
If you're fast and lucky - we've got a few keys waiting for you, so you could dive into the
